title: Northgate Retail Bank Credit Line Schedule for Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards
content:
For each card of Marlowe & Finch Credit Cards, Northgate Retail Bank sets the range of the credit line assigned at approval, the highest line the account can reach, and the figures a credit line increase is measured against.

| | Store Card | Store Card Plus | Store Card Elite | Mastercard | Platinum Mastercard | World Elite Mastercard |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Lowest line at approval (USD) | 300.00 | not applicable | not applicable | 1000.00 | not applicable | 5000.00 |
| Highest line at approval (USD) | 3500.00 | not applicable | not applicable | 12000.00 | not applicable | 30000.00 |
| Highest line reachable through increases (USD) | 8000.00 | 10000.00 | 12500.00 | 20000.00 | 25000.00 | 50000.00 |
| Full calendar months since the account opened | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Full calendar months since the last credit line change | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Most recent consecutive on-time statements | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Largest single increase, percent of the current line | 25 | 35 | 50 | 25 | 35 | 50 |

## Definitions

1. **Lowest and highest line at approval** — the bounds of the credit line assigned when the account is approved. Cards reached only by status upgrade are never opened by approval, so the figures do not apply to them.
2. **Highest line reachable through increases** — the maximum credit line the account can reach through credit line increases.
3. **Full calendar months since the account opened** — the full calendar months that must have passed since the account's opened date before a credit line increase is considered.
4. **Full calendar months since the last credit line change** — the full calendar months that must have passed since the last credit line change before another increase is considered.
5. **Most recent consecutive on-time statements** — the number of most recent consecutive statements whose minimum payment must have been received by the due date for an increase.
6. **Largest single increase** — the largest single credit line increase, as a percent of the current credit line.

## Worked reading (hypothetical lines)

On a Marlowe & Finch Store Card Plus with a hypothetical current line of USD 4000.00, the largest single increase is 35 percent of 4000.00, that is USD 1400.00, and the highest reachable line is USD 10000.00. On a Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard with a hypothetical line of USD 40000.00, 50 percent would be USD 20000.00, but the line can reach no more than USD 50000.00.
